Validation_Zhang_Chen_UFAD.ghx:
VALIDATION - Zhang & Chen (2006) UFAD chamber

The underfloor-air-distribution experiment of Zhang & Chen (Atmospheric Environment 40, 3396-3408, doi:10.1016/j.atmosenv.2006.01.014): a 4.91 x 4.31 x 2.44 m room, air supplied at floor level through two 0.26 m square diffusers (0.70 m/s at 20.4 / 19.9 degC) and extracted through the ceiling. Four occupants dissipate 100 W each (closed boxes carved out of the room as obstacles), six flush ceiling luminaires 64 W each, and every wall holds its measured temperature from the paper Table 2. The case solves buoyant stratified mixed convection on OpenFOAM 12 (fluid module, k-epsilon).

WHAT TO EXPECT - temperature rising continuously floor to ceiling at roughly 1.1-1.7 K/m, supply jets climbing to about 1.5 m before falling back, and thermal plumes above the occupants.

MESH - Cell Size defaults to 0.10 m for a fast first run; the paper grid was 389k cells (about 0.022 here, ~15 min on 16 cores). The quantitative validation (digitised measurements, error metrics, profile figure) lives in the Eddy3D repo: MetaFOAM.Lib.Tests / TestZhangChenUfad*.

PROVENANCE - room, loads and temperatures are the paper values; diffuser, occupant and luminaire POSITIONS are reconstructed (the paper publishes no coordinates), matching the Simvia code_saturne setup.
